title: Silent Gear Spear Fix
description: Rotates Silent Gear's spears 90 degrees clockwise, preventing them from floating in your hand. Initially intended for use with Better Combat, though it should work just as well without it.
body: Rotates [Silent Gear](https://modrinth.com/mod/silent-gear)'s spears 90 degrees clockwise, preventing them from floating in your hand. Initially intended for use with [Better Combat](https://modrinth.com/mod/better-combat), though it should work just as well without it.
